entry.false: out of scope: no plan write, no launch, no SDK effect

native.dispatch: GGML_ASSERT src0 F32 or (F16 and dst F16); GGML_ASSERT src1 I32 or I64; F32 src0 selects set_rows_cuda<src_t,idx_t,dst_t>

strides.dst_q4_0: s1..s3 = nb1..nb3 BYTES; the kernel divides the row sum by 18

native.broadcast: i10=i01; i11=i02%ne11; i12=i03%ne12; decode tmp=(u32)i_base; i00=tmp%ne00; tmp/=ne00; i01=tmp%ne01; tmp/=ne01; i02=tmp%ne02; i03=tmp/ne02

packet_args.0: dst tensor handle for the GGML_OP_SET_ROWS result

plan.layout: flat key/index writes performed by host.goose; key7/8/9 are launch metadata

device_binding.argument_map: bx=blockIdx.x, tx=threadIdx.x, nt=blockDim.x=256 (device nt is block size, not host key7[0] thread count), ne_total=key7[0], ne00..ne02=key9[0..2], ne11=key9[3], ne12=key9[4], s01..s03=key4, s10..s12=key5, s1..s3=key6, dst_rows=key7[14], explicittype=(key7[11]==1), has_cap=true

validation: reject null handles, non-SET_ROWS op, src0 != F32, src1 not I32/I64, dst not F32/Q4_0 before plan write or launch
all ne/nb dims positive; n10>=n01; d0>=n00; d2>=n02; d3>=n03
ne_total product checked for u64 overflow; Q4_0 thread count <= 2^27 so i*32 fits u32; F32 thread count <= 2^32 so i fits u32
byte spans sp0, sp1, spd fit INT64; base+span fits u64
fastdiv is metadata only; logical / and % reproduce native decode for 1..2^32-1

bounds_contract.owner: caller owns every allocation and all row destinations
bounds_contract.host_checks: representability of byte spans, exact element/byte stride units, nonnegative whole-element strides, overflow, and dst-vs-source overlap
bounds_contract.host_cannot_check: allocation sizes and src1 values; the host never reads src1 and adds no GPU synchronization
bounds_contract.device_row_guard: launch adapter must pass has_cap=true and dst_rows=key7[14]; device returns before any store when dst_row<0 or dst_row>=dst_rows
bounds_contract.refusal: if has_cap=true/dst_rows cannot be supplied this path must not launch; no memory safety is claimed for has_cap=false

aliasing.dst_vs_src0: any overlap fails code 44; device contract lists dst/src0 aliasing as unsupported, so exact-base in-place is not claimed safe

unsupported: src0 types other than F32 (native F16 specialization out of scope)
dst types other than F32 and Q4_0 (F16, BF16, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, IQ4_NL and all *_K)
any dst/src0 or dst/src1 alias, and overlapping row destinations between threads
zero/negative dims, non-whole-element strides, out-of-span caller pointers
NaN/Inf float-to-int behavior is native-undefined and not claimed
fidelity_notes: Q4_0 absmax uses strict < so the first maximum and its sign (including signed zero) survive
d=vmax/-8; id=(d!=0)?1/d:0; half scale is an RN hardware store; no fused multiply-add
packing: low nibble element j, high nibble element j+16; (int8_t)(x+8.5) truncation then min(15,..) clamp

device OR requirement: final packing must use Goose's supported bitwise OR; the supplied device draft's lo+h4-(lo&h4) is integer-exact arithmetic emulation and is recorded as an open fidelity item, not claimed final
device fastdiv is replaced by logical / and % (same for validated ranges); host writes magic only as metadata
no host GPU-index synchronization, no fabricated plan field, no native numerical function called
compatibility_notes: device nt parameter is blockDim.x=256; host key7[0] is the thread count ne_total - do not conflate
device contract marks all dst/src0/src1 aliasing unsupported; host refuses rather than pretending an in-place route
has_cap is not a separate plan word in the supplied draft; adapter derives it as true from the always-present dst_rows key7[14]
checks: host.goose was not compiled or executed here; stage3 build, GPU bit-exact, rollback and Apex acceptance are controller-owned
